barriers._note: Railings and walls: how they look (height, thickness, colour) and their collider — always at least minThickness thick and extraHeight taller than what's drawn (1.2 m: even a car launched off a 300 km/h hit can't vault one). auto: railings OSM often lacks (marked estimated).

auto._note: Railings OSM often lacks, added and marked estimated: both sides of bridges, motorway edges and the median between a motorway's carriageways, and road edges where the ground drops more than drop m within reach m (for at least minRun m), away from junctions.

lamps._note: Street lamps: OSM's (highway=street_lamp, man_made=street_lamp) first; then estimated ones from the road model on lit roads (lit=yes; the alwaysLitClasses — main roads, lit through parks too; or urban classes when lit isn't tagged, in built-up areas; never lit=no): spacing m by kind, at the kerb (offset m outside the visual edge) or in a median wider than medianMin m, both sides of roads at least bothSidesWidth m wide; one at every junction corner of a lit road, two at crossings; tunnels continuous at tunnel m, on the wall. Never in a lane, on a road surface, or under a deck (the exclusion mask). A mapped lamp within mappedRadius m stands in for an estimated one. Height, arm, colour, and the rendering's real-light count.
